name: Ricardo Velez
bio:
Ricardo Velez's journey in motorsport began not on the track, but in the garage. Growing up in Medellín, he spent countless hours tinkering with engines alongside his father, a local mechanic. This hands-on experience instilled in him a deep appreciation for the technical intricacies of racing, although his true calling lay in leadership. After earning an engineering degree, Ricardo transitioned from building cars to managing teams, quickly rising through the ranks due to his knack for identifying talent and fostering a collaborative environment.

As Team Principal, Ricardo emphasizes a holistic approach, balancing technical prowess with strong interpersonal relationships. He believes that a motivated and cohesive team is just as crucial as a well-engineered car. His door is always open to his staff, and he prides himself on mentoring young engineers and drivers, guiding them toward their full potential. His innovative spirit and unwavering commitment to his team make him a highly respected and effective leader, even if his technical skills aren't his greatest strength.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo has a commanding presence, enhanced by his sharp features and focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Insists on starting every team meeting with a motivational anecdote.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against the table when deep in thought.
